quality.rationale: UI reposition, collapsible Layers Quick Add, collapsible layer list, horizontal and vertical even distribution, preview-pane Layout I/O, preview pan, user-controlled zoom on preset changes, fixed output-frame preview during off-canvas drags, outside-frame deselection, Colors layout cleanup, draggable popup Adjust single-color picker, hidden Colors-side Brand kit registration buttons, expanded shape kinds, rounded polygon corners, Image Lab asset-row entry and modal cleanup, resizable Default and Browser template lists, popup-style OBS preview, Schedule templates, expanded Motion/easing controls, expanded hosted font options, and vertical text display-bound resizing are implemented and verified with automated tests, production build, and headless Chromium runtime gate. Coverage includes exactly 38 bundled default templates, hidden left Layouts tab, removed guided start, hidden Templates Brand kit setup, CSV/HTML persistence, inspector editing, Colors collapses, WebP export, mobile no-overflow, user-facing docs, and QCDS evidence. Cross-browser, real-device, and real OBS setup edge cases remain future work.

cost.rationale: Static browser-only GitHub Pages app with no backend, no paid service dependency, browser-local edit state, template, color, saved palette, and custom font storage, and client-side YouTube thumbnail import.

delivery.rationale: TODO and local Issues are closed, implementation and docs are aligned, README, user guide, and screenshot guide are present, QCDS evidence is recorded, tests/build/runtime gate pass, and docs packaging remains available through the existing workflow. A fresh remote Pages run after this commit remains pending until pushed.

satisfaction.rationale: Requested UI cleanup and follow-up changes passed validation: left Layouts is hidden, guided start is removed, Templates Brand kit setup is hidden, Quick Add is moved to Layers with collapse controls, the layer list collapses, even distribution is added, preview zoom stays user-controlled with pan available, off-canvas dragging keeps zoom scale and output-frame size stable, clicking outside the output frame clears selection, Colors places the pattern dropdown beside the wheel and removes Brand kit registration buttons, Adjust opens a draggable popup alpha-capable single-color picker from Fill/Stroke displays, redundant opacity controls are removed, Shape supports Diamond/Pentagon/Hexagon/Star with rounded polygon corners, Image Lab opens only from imported asset rows and no longer duplicates source/import controls, chroma-key settings are separated from processed-layer creation, Default and Browser template lists are resizable, and OBS preview opens a popup-style canvas-only document. CSV/HTML import/export persistence works from the preview pane, WebP export works, and QCDS evidence is updated. Remaining satisfaction risk is broader real-user font files, real-device checks, non-Chromium browser coverage, and real OBS capture behavior.

openItemsBeforeReview: Default templates 38 practical layouts with Schedule, Motion, weekly Sunday-start templates, expanded easing, and Motion/OBS preview
